# Getting help with Meta-Capp

Meta-Capp has a single maintainer. Picking the right channel gets you an answer faster,
in English or French.

| You want to… | Go to |
|---|---|
| Ask how to install it, run Ollama, pick a model, use a feature | [Discussions ▸ Q&A](https://github.com/cyyyp100/meta-capp/discussions/categories/q-a) |
| Suggest a feature or a pedagogy idea | [Discussions ▸ Ideas](https://github.com/cyyyp100/meta-capp/discussions/categories/ideas) |
| Tell how a real reading session went | the [Beta feedback form](https://github.com/cyyyp100/meta-capp/issues/new?template=beta_feedback.yml) |
| Report a reproducible bug | the [bug report form](https://github.com/cyyyp100/meta-capp/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) |
| Report a security vulnerability | privately, as [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/cyyyp100/meta-capp/blob/main/SECURITY.md) explains, never in a public issue |
| Contribute code or docs | [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/cyyyp100/meta-capp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) |
| Ask about Meta-Capp Pro | [Editions: Local vs Pro](https://github.com/cyyyp100/meta-capp#editions--local-vs-pro) |

Search the existing discussions and issues first: the answer may already be there. Never
post a document or a log without reading it: they stay on your computer until you publish
them yourself.
